name: Ginoza (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ginoza village emblem in orange: an outlined ring crossed by a winged device of horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Ginoza, a village in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 November 1976.

features.role: Ginoza village emblem — an outlined ring crossed by a winged device of horizontal strokes
